stories.title: Charity to end after 30 years over financial risks
stories.summary: Ace Anglia, which works with people with learning difficulties, says its closure is "unavoidable".

stories.title: Council worker's police order for protest flag removal
stories.summary: She is seen on CCTV removing flags at a former RAF base where the government wants to house asylum seekers.

stories.title: Therapist struck off for sharing child's details
stories.summary: Occupational therapist Margaret Ellis is struck off for serious professional misconduct, panel says.

stories.title: Doctor who licked beer off colleague can work again
stories.summary: The Medical Practitioners Tribunal Service says Dr Mark Johnson is again fit to practise.

stories.title: Artist creates graffiti studio made entirely of felt
stories.summary: Lucy Sparrow is known across the world for her art exhibitions made entirely of felt fabric.

stories.title: 'Doctors put my sickness down to pregnancy - but it was abuse'
stories.summary: GPs in Norfolk and Suffolk will be trained to help their patients open up about domestic abuse.

stories.title: Roads closed as firefighters tackle town centre blaze
stories.summary: About six crews are called to the three-storey building in Ipswich.

stories.title: Nine police staff face action over domestic murder
stories.summary: Five will face disciplinary hearings while four will undertake a practice review, says regulator.

stories.title: Rail bridge tops 'Britain's most bashed' list again
stories.summary: The A5 Watling Street railway bridge tops Network Rail's 2025-26 list with 26 strikes.

stories.title: Town centre Post Office reopens in new location
stories.summary: The branch has relocated after being forced to move out of its previous premises.

stories.title: Plans submitted for new roundabout on A-road
stories.summary: Developers claim a repurposed business park could create 1,600 jobs.

stories.title: McAteer 'intelligence' earns praise from Ipswich boss
stories.summary: Ipswich Town boss David Wright praised the football intelligence of Wales international Mary McAteer following her first goal for the club.
